arms.meaning: Pass the three observed frozen Physical JEPA v5 outputs into the unchanged risk adapter.

feature_intervention.replacement_source: the frozen full adapter's development-set feature means at the same raw positions

arms.meaning: Compute the same frozen JEPA outputs, then replace only those three values by their preregistered development means immediately before the unchanged adapter score.

changed_factor: Only the values presented at raw risk-adapter feature indices 22-24: observed frozen JEPA outputs versus their preregistered development means.
claim_boundary: This paired, locally designed and executed simulator ablation identifies the direct closed-loop contribution of observed frozen JEPA output values versus registered development-mean masking on this fixed software pipeline and seed range. It does not establish architecture-wide causality, planner superiority, learned-safety superiority, independent replication or assessment, HIL, physical safety, deployment safety, or promotion eligibility.
constant_factors: Safety-Gymnasium 1.0.0 SafetyPointGoal1-v0 task and source digest
128 paired seeds, 500-step episode limit, and two-worker execution
frozen Physical JEPA v5 model and inference path
full v14 safety_summary risk adapter, coefficients, normalization, and bias
learned risk operating threshold 0.72 with no ablation retuning
rule warning and its hazard-closeness threshold 0.97
privileged grid A-star planner and every planner parameter
one-command deterministic tangent correction and every correction parameter
20-step nominal-controller danger oracle and all metric definitions
warning union, cooldown, motion predicate, and action-application runtime

prospective_boundary.registration_search: Before this protocol was written, a repository search found no recorded seed or registered range from 9000 through 9127 in docs, scripts, or README.md.

research_question: With the warning pipeline, planner, correction, runtime, policy, and operating-threshold selection fixed, what direct causal contribution do the three observed frozen Physical JEPA v5 output values make to warnings, interventions, completion, and simulator cost on paired fresh Safety-Gymnasium seeds?

threshold_selection.rule: Reuse the v14 selected candidate's learned_risk_threshold exactly in both arms; perform no new selection or retuning.

uncertainty.scope: Episode bootstrap conditions on the frozen fitted model, frozen fitted adapter, fixed masking intervention, and registered seed-generating process.
